text: As the overhang between AI’s expanding capabilities & the degree to which AI capabilities are used grows, the penalty of locking into a “good enough” solution based on today’s AI limits grows too. Firms need to make sure they can benefit from vast Lab investment into better AIs.

AI transforming the game industry:

The Last Masterpiece of the human-only era of game design (GTA 6) is coming. Major studios are going to accelerate with AI. Anon devs & communities doing insane mashups. And indies are stuck with anti-AI customers

Other industries will follow,
